comments.author: @tammyshuler9221
comments.text: We live on the land. Large oak trees shade our deck and roof throughout the day. Gardens surround us. We can view peppers, tomatoes, herbs, and broccoli growing from our kitchen window. I love the great outdoors. We watch the sunrise and the sunset. Mid-day is hot in summer and awesome in the winter. We picked over 20 gallons of blueberries this summer. The figs and muscadines are coming next, then persimmons. My dream is to share this land with others, who will dwell in micro cottages under the canopy of perimeter trees surrounding the gardens. But....... so many who have visited are not interested in work. This is a problem.  She want to just scroll on their phones. We did not have internet here for 13 years. We do now. It is a curse really. Many would love to watch what we do here on YouTube. But......I want to inspire and empower 'doers, not attract viewers. My heart aches for those who are stuck in the cities. They are prisons, torture chambers.  The one and only God, Creator of all things living, hates cities! But.......he loves you. He had a better plan for his creation than city dwelling. Those who understand this fact about God have failed to make a way for city dwellers to escape and to find peace, work, sustainability, and God as they walk toward sovereignty, dignity, and freedom in Christ.    You are loved of God!
